summary: Join our specialized course on the legal aspects of commercial real estate transactions. Learn from experts and elevate your professional capabilities today.
lede: Commercial real estate transaction law covers the rights, obligations, and contract terms involved in property deals. For property, facilities, finance, and corporate services professionals, this course supports reviewing and negotiating leases, purchases, and financing documents before commitments are made. Participants practise interpreting key clauses, conducting due diligence on title and occupancy, and identifying risks in financing, property use, maintenance, and exit terms.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly deal with or are affected by commercial real estate transactions.
modules: Legal Foundations of Commercial Real Estate
Types of Commercial Property Rights and Interests
Legal Due Diligence in Property Transactions
Risk Management and Compliance in Commercial Real Estate
Financing and Security for Real Estate Transactions
Negotiation of Commercial Real Estate Contracts
Practical Case Clinic: Learning from Real Transactions
prerequisites: Participants should have basic knowledge of commercial real estate transactions and experience in handling or influencing real estate decisions. No prior legal training is required, but familiarity with business and property management is advantageous.
